- [ ] **Step 4: Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-logs.js`.**

```js
/* Docker Manager logs: the follow panel of the container drawer, the stack pane and the external project pane. A classic script
   (window.DockerManagerLogs) with no DOM work at load.
   - createModel: the pure part. A ring of 5000 lines (older ones fall off), a filter by text and by service, the follow flag with the
     count of lines that arrived while it was off, the stderr flag, ANSI codes and carriage-return progress output removed, and what a
     reconnect needs: the time of the newest line (`since`) and a duplicate filter for the lines the server repeats.
   - followUrl: the URL of the three SSE routes (container, stack, external project).
   - create(deps).open(el, target, options): the panel. One EventSource per open panel; it follows only while the panel is active
     (the tab is shown), reconnects with backoff and `since` after a broken connection, shows the notices and the end message of the
     server, and appends the lines to the DOM in animation frames. Lines are built with the DOM API (textContent), never as HTML. */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const BASE = '/api/docker-manager';
    const TAILS = [100, 200, 500, 1000, 5000];
    const DEFAULT_TAIL = { container: 200, stack: 100, project: 100 };
    const MAX_LINES = 5000;
    const RECONNECT_MS = [1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 15000];
    // After `end` with these codes the host may come back: follow again by itself. Every other end waits for the Reconnect button.
    const RETRY_CODES = ['host_unreachable', 'timeout', 'docker_error', 'internal_error', 'network'];
    // A 4xx answer to the diagnosis ends the retries whatever its code; these codes do the same for the 5xx answers that mean "not now".
    const FINAL_CODES = ['docker_disabled', 'docker_hosts_unavailable', 'stacks_unavailable'];
    const ANSI = /\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[ -/]*[@-~]/g;
    const HUES = 6;
    const enc = encodeURIComponent;

    // ---- the pure part -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    // The text of one log line for the screen: colour codes out, and a carriage-return progress bar reduced to its last state.
    function cleanText(value) {
        let text = String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(ANSI, '');
        if (text.includes('\r')) {
            const parts = text.split('\r').filter(part => part !== '');
            text = parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : '';
        }
        return text;
    }

    const hueOf = name => {
        let hash = 0;
        for (const ch of String(name || '')) hash = (hash * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) % 9973;
        return hash % HUES;
    };

    function entryOf(raw, id) {
        const r = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
        const t = String(r.t || ''), ms = Date.parse(t);
        const entry = { id, t, ms: Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : 0, s: r.s === 'err' ? 'err' : 'out', text: cleanText(r.text), trunc: !!r.trunc, svc: String(r.svc || ''), ctr: String(r.ctr || ''), el: null };
        entry.key = entry.ctr + '|' + entry.svc + '|' + entry.t + '|' + entry.text;
        return entry;
    }

    function createModel(options) {
        const max = options && options.max > 0 ? Math.floor(options.max) : MAX_LINES;
        let lines = [], seq = 0, query = '', follow = true, unseen = 0, lastMs = 0, lastT = '', lastKeys = new Set(), resume = null;
        const hidden = new Set(), services = [];

        const matches = entry => !hidden.has(entry.svc) && (!query || entry.text.toLowerCase().includes(query) || entry.svc.toLowerCase().includes(query));

        // Adds the lines of one batch. Returns {added: entries kept, shown: how many of them pass the filter, dropped: entries pushed out
        // of the ring}. After beginResume() the lines a reconnect repeats (older than the newest line, or the same line again) are skipped.
        function append(raws) {
            const added = [];
            for (const raw of Array.isArray(raws) ? raws : []) {
                const entry = entryOf(raw, ++seq);
                if (resume) {
                    if (entry.ms && entry.ms < resume.ms) continue;
                    if (entry.ms === resume.ms && resume.keys.has(entry.key)) continue;
                    resume = null;
                }
                if (entry.ms > lastMs) { lastMs = entry.ms; lastT = entry.t; lastKeys = new Set([entry.key]); }
                else if (entry.ms === lastMs) { if (entry.t) lastT = entry.t; lastKeys.add(entry.key); }
                if (entry.svc && !services.includes(entry.svc)) services.push(entry.svc);
                lines.push(entry);
                added.push(entry);
            }
            const dropped = lines.length > max ? lines.splice(0, lines.length - max) : [];
            return { added, shown: added.filter(matches).length, dropped };
        }

        return {
            max, append, matches,
            visible: () => lines.filter(matches),
            all: () => lines.slice(),
            count: () => lines.length,
            // Forget the lines on screen but keep where the stream stood, so a reconnect does not bring them back.
            clear() { lines = []; unseen = 0; },
            // Forget everything, including the resume point (another tail was chosen: the stream starts from scratch).
            reset() { lines = []; unseen = 0; lastMs = 0; lastT = ''; lastKeys = new Set(); resume = null; services.length = 0; },
            beginResume() { resume = lastMs ? { ms: lastMs, keys: new Set(lastKeys) } : null; },
            lastTime: () => lastT,
            setQuery(value) { query = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase(); },
            toggleService(name) { if (hidden.has(name)) hidden.delete(name); else hidden.add(name); return !hidden.has(name); },
            serviceShown: name => !hidden.has(name),
            addService(name) { if (name && !services.includes(name)) services.push(name); },
            services: () => services.slice(),
            isFollowing: () => follow,
            setFollow(value) { follow = !!value; if (follow) unseen = 0; },
            addUnseen(count) { unseen += count; },
            unseen: () => unseen,
            // The visible lines as text for the clipboard; with timestamps and service names when asked for.
            text(o) {
                const withTime = !!(o && o.timestamps);
                return lines.filter(matches).map(entry => (withTime && entry.t ? entry.t + ' ' : '') + (entry.svc ? '[' + entry.svc + '] ' : '') + entry.text).join('\n');
            }
        };
    }

    // target = {kind: 'container', hostId, ref} | {kind: 'stack', hostId, name} | {kind: 'project', hostId, name}. A reconnect asks for
    // everything since the newest line it has (up to the ring size) instead of a tail.
    function followUrl(target, o) {
        const opt = o || {}, host = BASE + '/hosts/' + enc(target.hostId);
        let path;
        if (target.kind === 'stack') path = host + '/stacks/' + enc(target.name) + '/logs';
        else if (target.kind === 'project') path = host + '/projects/' + enc(target.name) + '/logs';
        else path = host + '/containers/' + enc(target.ref) + '/logs';
        const query = ['follow=1', 'tail=' + (opt.since ? MAX_LINES : TAILS.includes(opt.tail) ? opt.tail : DEFAULT_TAIL[target.kind] || 200)];
        if (opt.since) query.push('since=' + enc(opt.since));
        return path + '?' + query.join('&');
    }

    // The diagnosis of a failed stream request (store.diagnose: the error info with its HTTP status) is final for any 4xx answer and for
    // the codes in FINAL_CODES; a 5xx answer, a timeout and a network failure are tried again.
    const isFinalDiagnosis = info => !!info && ((info.status >= 400 && info.status < 500) || FINAL_CODES.includes(info.code));

    // What a notice talks about: its services, else its container. attached and detached name the first service, else the container.
    const noticeNames = notice => (Array.isArray(notice.services) && notice.services.length ? notice.services.map(String) : notice.container ? [String(notice.container)] : []);
    const noticeName = notice => (Array.isArray(notice.services) && notice.services.length ? String(notice.services[0]) : String(notice.container || ''));

    // Adds a notice to the list (at most 4 entries). The server sends one not_followed notice for every container whose history or follow
    // failed and one for the services the stream budget left out: all of them become one entry (at the place of the first) with the
    // services of every notice, each once, and the first message as detail.
    function mergeNotice(list, notice) {
        const n = notice && typeof notice === 'object' ? notice : {};
        if (n.code !== 'not_followed') return list.concat([n]).slice(-4);
        const existing = list.find(item => item.code === 'not_followed');
        const services = [...new Set((existing ? existing.services : []).concat(noticeNames(n)))];
        const merged = { code: 'not_followed', message: existing && existing.message ? existing.message : String(n.message || ''), services };
        return (existing ? list.map(item => (item === existing ? merged : item)) : list.concat([merged])).slice(-4);
    }

    // ---- the panel -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, esc, views, copy, diagnose } = deps;
        const openSource = deps.eventSource;
        const setT = typeof deps.setTimeout === 'function' ? deps.setTimeout : (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms);
        const clearT = typeof deps.clearTimeout === 'function' ? deps.clearTimeout : id => clearTimeout(id);
        const frame = typeof deps.requestFrame === 'function' ? deps.requestFrame : fn => (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function' ? requestAnimationFrame(fn) : setT(fn, 16));
        const lang = deps.lang || 'en';

        function open(el, target, options) {
            const opt = options || {};
            const model = createModel(), lifetime = new AbortController(), signal = lifetime.signal;
            const grouped = target.kind !== 'container';
            let tail = TAILS.includes(opt.tail) ? opt.tail : DEFAULT_TAIL[target.kind] || 200;
            let source = null, active = false, disposed = false, phase = 'idle', failures = 0, retryTimer = 0, opened = false, ended = null, flushing = false;
            let pending = [], notices = [], timestamps = false, chipSig = '', searchTimer = 0, finalError = null, started = false, lastUrl = '';
            const knownServices = new Set(Array.isArray(target.services) ? target.services : []);

            const pad = (n, size) => String(n).padStart(size || 2, '0');
            const clock = ms => { const d = new Date(ms); return pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds()) + '.' + pad(d.getMilliseconds(), 3); };

            el.innerHTML = '<div class="dm-lp" data-logs data-ts="off" data-wrap="on">'
                + '<div class="dm-lp-bar"><label class="dm-inline"><span>' + esc(t('logs_tail')) + '</span><select data-lp-tail' + (grouped ? ' title="' + esc(t('logs_tail_each')) + '"' : '') + '>'
                + TAILS.map(n => '<option value="' + n + '"' + (n === tail ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + n + '</option>').join('') + '</select></label>'
                + '<input type="search" class="dm-lp-search" data-lp-search autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="' + esc(t('logs_search')) + '" aria-label="' + esc(t('logs_search')) + '">'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn dm-toggle" data-lp-follow aria-pressed="true"><span>' + esc(t('logs_follow')) + '</span></button>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn dm-toggle" data-lp-ts aria-pressed="false"><span>' + esc(t('logs_timestamps')) + '</span></button>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn dm-toggle" data-lp-wrap aria-pressed="true"><span>' + esc(t('logs_wrap')) + '</span></button>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-lp-copy><span>' + esc(t('logs_copy')) + '</span></button>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-lp-clear><span>' + esc(t('logs_clear')) + '</span></button>'
                + '<span class="dm-lp-state" data-lp-state role="status"></span>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-lp-reconnect hidden><span>' + esc(t('logs_reconnect')) + '</span></button></div>'
                + '<div class="dm-lp-chips" data-lp-chips role="group" aria-label="' + esc(t('overview_services')) + '" hidden></div>'
                + '<div class="dm-lp-notices" data-lp-notices></div>'
                + '<div class="dm-lp-body"><div class="dm-lp-view" data-lp-view tabindex="0" role="log" aria-live="off" aria-label="' + esc(t('logs_label', { name: target.label || target.name || target.ref || '' })) + '"></div>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn is-primary dm-lp-new" data-lp-new hidden></button><p class="dm-lp-empty" data-lp-empty></p></div></div>';
            const q = selector => el.querySelector(selector);
            const root = q('[data-logs]'), view = q('[data-lp-view]'), stateEl = q('[data-lp-state]'), emptyEl = q('[data-lp-empty]'), newEl = q('[data-lp-new]');
            const chipsEl = q('[data-lp-chips]'), noticesEl = q('[data-lp-notices]'), reconnectEl = q('[data-lp-reconnect]'), followEl = q('[data-lp-follow]'), searchEl = q('[data-lp-search]');

            // ---- painting ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

            function lineEl(entry) {
                const row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'dm-ll';
                if (entry.s === 'err') {
                    row.dataset.s = 'err';
                    const label = document.createElement('span');
                    label.className = 'dm-sr-only';
                    label.textContent = t('logs_stderr') + ' ';
                    row.append(label);
                }
                if (entry.ms) {
                    const time = document.createElement('time');
                    time.className = 'dm-ll-ts';
                    time.dateTime = entry.t;
                    time.title = entry.t;
                    time.textContent = clock(entry.ms);
                    row.append(time);
                }
                if (entry.svc) {
                    const svc = document.createElement('span');
                    svc.className = 'dm-ll-svc';
                    svc.dataset.h = String(hueOf(entry.svc));
                    svc.textContent = entry.svc;
                    row.append(svc);
                }
                const text = document.createElement('span');
                text.className = 'dm-ll-text';
                text.textContent = entry.text;
                row.append(text);
                if (entry.trunc) {
                    const cut = document.createElement('span');
                    cut.className = 'dm-ll-cut';
                    cut.title = t('logs_truncated');
                    cut.textContent = '…';
                    row.append(cut);
                }
                entry.el = row;
                return row;
            }
            const nearBottom = () => view.scrollHeight - view.scrollTop - view.clientHeight < 24;
            const toBottom = () => { view.scrollTop = view.scrollHeight; };

            function paintState() {
                let text = t('logs_state_' + phase);
                if (phase === 'ended' && ended && ended.reason === 'error') text = t('logs_end_error', { message: views.errorText({ code: ended.code, message: ended.message }) });
                else if (phase === 'error' && finalError) text = t('logs_end_error', { message: views.errorText(finalError) });
                stateEl.textContent = text;
                stateEl.dataset.phase = phase;
                reconnectEl.hidden = !(phase === 'ended' || phase === 'error');
                followEl.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(model.isFollowing()));
                const waiting = model.visible().length === 0;
                emptyEl.hidden = !waiting;
                emptyEl.textContent = waiting ? (model.count() ? t('logs_no_match') : phase === 'live' || phase === 'connecting' ? t('logs_empty_live') : '') : '';
                const unseen = model.unseen();
                newEl.hidden = model.isFollowing() || unseen === 0;
                newEl.textContent = unseen ? t('logs_new', { count: unseen }) : '';
            }

            function paintChips() {
                if (!grouped) return;
                for (const name of model.services()) knownServices.add(name);
                const names = [...knownServices].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, lang, { numeric: true }));
                const sig = names.join('\n') + '|' + names.filter(name => !model.serviceShown(name)).join('\n');
                if (sig === chipSig) return;
                chipSig = sig;
                chipsEl.hidden = names.length < 2;
                chipsEl.innerHTML = names.map(name => '<button type="button" class="dm-chipbtn" data-lp-chip="' + esc(name) + '" aria-pressed="' + model.serviceShown(name) + '"><span class="dm-ll-svc" data-h="' + hueOf(name) + '">' + esc(name) + '</span></button>').join('');
            }

            function noticeText(notice) {
                switch (notice.code) {
                    case 'not_followed': return t('logs_notice_not_followed', { services: noticeNames(notice).join(', ') });
                    case 'attached': return t('logs_notice_attached', { name: noticeName(notice) });
                    case 'detached': return t('logs_notice_detached', { name: noticeName(notice) });
                    case 'truncated_history': return t('logs_notice_truncated_history');
                    default: return String(notice.message || '');
                }
            }
            function paintNotices() {
                noticesEl.replaceChildren(...notices.map(notice => {
                    const p = document.createElement('p');
                    p.className = 'dm-lp-notice';
                    p.dataset.code = notice.code;
                    p.textContent = noticeText(notice);
                    p.title = String(notice.message || '');
                    return p;
                }));
            }

            // Appends the pending lines in one go: the rows, the scroll position (follow) or the "n new" counter (paused).
            function flush() {
                flushing = false;
                if (disposed || !pending.length) return;
                const batch = pending;
                pending = [];
                const result = model.append(batch);
                for (const entry of result.dropped) { entry.el?.remove(); entry.el = null; }
                const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                for (const entry of result.added) if (model.matches(entry)) fragment.append(lineEl(entry));
                const following = model.isFollowing();
                view.append(fragment);
                if (following) toBottom(); else if (result.shown) { model.addUnseen(result.shown); }
                paintChips();
                paintState();
            }
            function queueFlush() {
                if (flushing) return;
                flushing = true;
                frame(flush);
            }

            // Rebuilds the rows from the model (filter, clear).
            function repaintAll() {
                view.replaceChildren();
                const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                for (const entry of model.visible()) fragment.append(lineEl(entry));
                view.append(fragment);
                if (model.isFollowing()) toBottom();
                paintChips();
                paintState();
            }

            // ---- connection ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

            function closeSource() {
                if (!source) return;
                const old = source;
                source = null;
                try { old.close(); } catch (error) { /* already closed */ }
            }
            function setPhase(next) { phase = next; paintState(); }

            function schedule(delay) {
                clearT(retryTimer);
                retryTimer = setT(() => { retryTimer = 0; connect(true); }, delay);
            }

            async function failedBeforeOpen() {
                // An EventSource does not tell why a request failed. Ask for the same URL as a plain request: the JSON error of the
                // server (stack_not_found, too_many_streams, ...) ends the retries; anything else (a down server) is retried.
                const mine = source;
                let info = null;
                if (typeof diagnose === 'function') {
                    try { info = await diagnose(lastUrl.slice(BASE.length)); } catch (error) { info = null; }
                }
                if (disposed || !active || source !== mine) return;
                if (isFinalDiagnosis(info)) { closeSource(); finalError = info; setPhase('error'); return; }
                retry();
            }

            function retry() {
                closeSource();
                if (disposed || !active) return;
                setPhase('reconnecting');
                schedule(RECONNECT_MS[Math.min(failures, RECONNECT_MS.length - 1)]);
                failures += 1;
            }

            // fresh = start from the tail (first connect, another tail); otherwise resume after the newest line.
            function connect(resuming) {
                if (disposed || !active || typeof openSource !== 'function') return;
                closeSource();
                clearT(retryTimer);
                retryTimer = 0;
                ended = null;
                finalError = null;
                opened = false;
                const resume = !!resuming && !!model.lastTime();
                if (resume) model.beginResume();
                lastUrl = followUrl(target, resume ? { since: model.lastTime() } : { tail });
                let next;
                try { next = openSource(lastUrl); } catch (error) { retry(); return; }
                source = next;
                started = true;
                setPhase(phase === 'live' ? 'live' : failures ? 'reconnecting' : 'connecting');
                const on = (type, handler) => next.addEventListener(type, event => {
                    if (source !== next || disposed) return;
                    let data = null;
                    try { data = JSON.parse(event && event.data); } catch (error) { data = null; }
                    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
                    if (!opened) { opened = true; failures = 0; if (phase !== 'live') setPhase('live'); }
                    handler(data);
                });
                next.onopen = () => { if (source !== next) return; opened = true; failures = 0; setPhase('live'); };
                on('lines', data => { if (Array.isArray(data.lines)) { pending.push(...data.lines); queueFlush(); } });
                on('notice', data => {
                    notices = mergeNotice(notices, data);
                    paintNotices();
                });
                on('end', data => {
                    ended = { reason: String(data.reason || 'ended'), code: String(data.code || ''), message: String(data.message || '') };
                    closeSource();
                    flush();
                    setPhase('ended');
                    if (ended.reason === 'error' && RETRY_CODES.includes(ended.code) && failures < RECONNECT_MS.length) { failures += 1; schedule(RECONNECT_MS[failures - 1]); }
                });
                next.onerror = () => {
                    if (source !== next || disposed) return;
                    if (opened) { retry(); return; }
                    void failedBeforeOpen();
                };
            }

            // ---- controls ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

            function setFollow(value) {
                model.setFollow(value);
                if (model.isFollowing()) toBottom();
                paintState();
            }
            view.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                const bottom = nearBottom();
                if (bottom && !model.isFollowing()) { model.setFollow(true); paintState(); } else if (!bottom && model.isFollowing()) { model.setFollow(false); paintState(); }
            }, { signal, passive: true });
            el.addEventListener('click', event => {
                const button = event.target.closest('button');
                if (!button || !el.contains(button)) return;
                if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-follow')) setFollow(!model.isFollowing());
                else if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-new')) { setFollow(true); view.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
                else if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-ts')) {
                    timestamps = !timestamps;
                    root.dataset.ts = timestamps ? 'on' : 'off';
                    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(timestamps));
                } else if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-wrap')) {
                    const on = root.dataset.wrap !== 'on';
                    root.dataset.wrap = on ? 'on' : 'off';
                    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
                } else if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-copy')) copy?.(model.text({ timestamps }));
                else if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-clear')) { model.clear(); repaintAll(); } else if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-reconnect')) { failures = 0; connect(true); } else if (button.hasAttribute('data-lp-chip')) {
                    model.toggleService(button.dataset.lpChip);
                    chipSig = '';
                    repaintAll();
                }
            }, { signal });
            q('[data-lp-tail]').addEventListener('change', event => {
                const next = Number(event.target.value);
                if (!TAILS.includes(next) || next === tail) return;
                tail = next;
                model.reset();
                notices = [];
                paintNotices();
                pending = [];
                chipSig = '';
                failures = 0;
                repaintAll();
                connect(false);
            }, { signal });
            searchEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
                clearT(searchTimer);
                searchTimer = setT(() => { model.setQuery(searchEl.value); repaintAll(); }, 150);
            }, { signal });
            // Escape clears the filter first; only an empty field lets the app close the drawer.
            searchEl.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
                if (event.key !== 'Escape' || !searchEl.value) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                searchEl.value = '';
                model.setQuery('');
                repaintAll();
            }, { signal });

            paintState();
            paintChips();

            return {
                // Follow while the panel is shown; leaving the tab closes the stream (the lines stay) and coming back resumes it.
                setActive(next) {
                    if (disposed || next === active) return;
                    active = !!next;
                    if (active) {
                        failures = 0;
                        connect(started);
                        if (model.isFollowing()) frame(toBottom);
                    } else {
                        clearT(retryTimer);
                        retryTimer = 0;
                        closeSource();
                        phase = 'idle';
                        paintState();
                    }
                },
                // The service chips of a stack follow its service list.
                update(next) {
                    if (disposed || !next) return;
                    for (const name of Array.isArray(next.services) ? next.services : []) knownServices.add(name);
                    paintChips();
                },
                focus() { view.focus({ preventScroll: true }); },
                model,
                isActive: () => active,
                phase: () => phase,
                dispose() {
                    if (disposed) return;
                    disposed = true;
                    clearT(retryTimer);
                    clearT(searchTimer);
                    closeSource();
                    lifetime.abort();
                    pending = [];
                    el.replaceChildren();
                }
            };
        }

        return { open };
    }

    window.DockerManagerLogs = { create, createModel, followUrl, mergeNotice, noticeName, isFinalDiagnosis, cleanText, hueOf, TAILS, DEFAULT_TAIL, MAX_LINES, RECONNECT_MS };
})();
```

### Task D5: The terminal panel

**Files:**

- Modify (test): `scripts/test-docker-manager-ui.mjs`
- Modify (test): `ui/i18n_lint_test.go`
- Modify: `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-store.js`
- Create: `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-terminal.js`
- Modify: `ui/lang/desktop/{cs,da,de,el,en,es,fr,hi,it,ja,nl,no,pl,pt,sv,zh}.json`

`docker-manager-terminal.js`: `create(deps).open(el, {hostId, targets, readonly, autofocus})` builds an xterm.js panel with the fit addon on a WebSocket to `.../containers/{full id}/terminal` (binary frames for input and output, `{"type":"resize"}` after every fit, `{"type":"end"}` before it closes). `targets()` is asked again on `update()`: one container in the drawer, the running service containers of a stack (a picker when there are two or more). It opens nothing for a helper container, a stopped container or in read-only mode (a message says why), asks first for a protected container (`confirmProtected`, then `?confirm=protected`) and, when the handshake fails, asks `store.diagnose` for the JSON error (a `container_protected_confirmation_required` opens the same confirmation and connects again; any other error is shown with `views.errorText`). The keydown never leaves the screen element (a bubble listener on it stops the event after xterm handled it), so Escape and Ctrl+K reach the shell and the app's palette and Spotlight never see them; `Ctrl+]` (custom key handler) or the Leave terminal button focuses the toolbar. Colours come from the `--dm-term-*` custom properties of the stylesheet, resolved through a probe element and a one-pixel canvas because `color-mix()` and `light-dark()` must reach xterm as plain `rgb()`; `minimumContrastRatio` is 4.5. The diagnosis after a confirmed protected container carries `?confirm=protected` too (`diagnosePath`), otherwise a later 429 or 502 would be answered as the protection again, and the service container id of a stack may be the 64-character one (it is matched by its first 12 characters). The store gets the generic `diagnose(path)` (the terminal diagnosis of D3 is its special case).

```js
/* Docker Manager terminal: an xterm.js panel on a WebSocket to /api/docker-manager/hosts/{h}/containers/{ref}/terminal, for the
   container drawer (one container) and the stack pane (a picker over the running service containers). A classic script
   (window.DockerManagerTerminal) with no DOM work at load.
   - Protocol (the same as the Containers page): input and output are binary frames; {"type":"resize","cols","rows"} and
     {"type":"end"} are text frames. Closing the panel sends "end" first, so the shell does not stay behind in the container.
   - A browser hides the answer of a refused handshake. After a failed attempt the panel asks the store for the JSON error of a plain
     GET (store.diagnose): a protected container (409 container_protected_confirmation_required) opens the confirmation dialog and
     connects again with ?confirm=protected; everything else is shown as a sentence.
   - Keys: every key goes to the terminal, Escape and Ctrl+K included; the keydown never leaves the screen element, so the palette,
     the shortcuts of the app and the desktop never see it. Ctrl+] (or the Leave terminal button) moves the focus to the toolbar.
   - Colours come from the --dm-term-* custom properties of the stylesheet, resolved through a probe element and a canvas so that
     color-mix() and light-dark() reach xterm as plain rgb(). */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const BASE = '/api/docker-manager';
    const THEME_KEYS = ['background', 'foreground', 'cursor', 'selectionBackground', 'black', 'red', 'green', 'yellow', 'blue', 'magenta', 'cyan', 'white'];
    const THEME_VARS = { background: 'bg', foreground: 'fg', cursor: 'cursor', selectionBackground: 'sel' };
    const enc = encodeURIComponent;

    // ---- pure helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function socketUrl(location, hostId, ref, confirmed) {
        const scheme = location && location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws';
        return scheme + '://' + (location && location.host) + BASE + '/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/containers/' + enc(ref) + '/terminal' + (confirmed ? '?confirm=protected' : '');
    }

    // The path (below /api/docker-manager) the diagnosis of a failed handshake asks for: the same URL as a plain GET. After the person confirmed a
    // protected container it carries the confirmation too, otherwise a later 429 or 502 would be answered as the protection again.
    function diagnosePath(hostId, ref, confirmed) {
        return '/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/containers/' + enc(ref) + '/terminal' + (confirmed ? '?confirm=protected' : '');
    }

    function targetOf(container, label) {
        const model = window.DockerManagerModel, c = container || {};
        return { ref: model.containerId(c), label: label || model.containerName(c), c, state: model.terminalState(c), protected: model.isProtected(c) };
    }
    // The picker of a stack: its running services, each with the container the list knows (for the lock and the full id). The service's
    // container id may be the 12-character id or the full one; the list's `id` is the 12-character one.
    function stackTargets(detail, containers) {
        const out = [], list = Array.isArray(containers) ? containers : [];
        for (const service of Array.isArray(detail && detail.service_list) ? detail.service_list : []) {
            if (!service || service.state !== 'running' || !service.container_id) continue;
            const wanted = String(service.container_id).slice(0, 12), c = list.find(item => item && String(item.id).slice(0, 12) === wanted);
            if (c) out.push(targetOf(c, service.name));
        }
        return out;
    }
    // Why no terminal is opened for a target without asking the server: a key of docker_manager.term_*, or ''.
    function blockedBy(target, readonly) {
        if (readonly) return 'term_readonly';
        if (!target) return 'term_none_running';
        if (target.state === 'helper') return 'term_helper';
        if (target.state === 'not_running') return 'term_not_running';
        return '';
    }
    const utf8 = text => new TextEncoder().encode(text);

    // Resolves a CSS colour (also color(srgb ...) from color-mix) to rgb()/rgba() through a one-pixel canvas.
    function toRgb(css) {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = canvas.height = 1;
        const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
        if (!context) return css;
        context.clearRect(0, 0, 1, 1);
        context.fillStyle = '#000000';
        context.fillStyle = css;
        context.fillRect(0, 0, 1, 1);
        const d = context.getImageData(0, 0, 1, 1).data;
        return d[3] === 255 ? 'rgb(' + d[0] + ', ' + d[1] + ', ' + d[2] + ')' : 'rgba(' + d[0] + ', ' + d[1] + ', ' + d[2] + ', ' + Math.round(d[3] / 255 * 100) / 100 + ')';
    }
    // The xterm theme for an element that defines the --dm-term-* properties.
    function readTheme(element) {
        const probe = document.createElement('span');
        probe.className = 'dm-tp-probe';
        element.append(probe);
        const theme = {};
        try {
            for (const key of THEME_KEYS) {
                probe.style.color = 'var(--dm-term-' + (THEME_VARS[key] || key) + ')';
                theme[key] = toRgb(getComputedStyle(probe).color);
            }
        } finally { probe.remove(); }
        for (const key of ['black', 'red', 'green', 'yellow', 'blue', 'magenta', 'cyan', 'white']) theme['bright' + key[0].toUpperCase() + key.slice(1)] = theme[key];
        theme.cursorAccent = theme.background;
        return theme;
    }

    // ---- the panel -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, esc, views, diagnose, confirmProtected } = deps;
        const openSocket = typeof deps.socket === 'function' ? deps.socket : url => new WebSocket(url);
        const where = deps.location || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location : { protocol: 'http:', host: '' });
        const frame = typeof deps.requestFrame === 'function' ? deps.requestFrame : fn => requestAnimationFrame(fn);

        // config = {hostId, targets: () => [target], readonly: () => bool, autofocus}. The targets function is asked again on update().
        function open(el, config) {
            const lifetime = new AbortController(), signal = lifetime.signal;
            let term = null, fit = null, socket = null, resizeObserver = null, disposed = false, active = false, phase = 'idle', message = '', generation = 0;
            let current = '', opened = false, optionSig = '', fitQueued = false, wantFocus = !!config.autofocus;
            const readonly = () => !!(config.readonly && config.readonly());
            const targets = () => (typeof config.targets === 'function' ? config.targets() : []);
            const targetFor = ref => targets().find(item => item.ref === ref) || null;

            el.innerHTML = '<div class="dm-tp" data-term>'
                + '<div class="dm-tp-bar"><label class="dm-inline" data-tp-pick-wrap hidden><span>' + esc(t('term_container')) + '</span><select data-tp-pick></select></label>'
                + '<span class="dm-tp-status" data-tp-status role="status"></span>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-tp-start hidden><span></span></button><span class="dm-spacer"></span>'
                + '<span class="dm-tp-hint">' + esc(t('term_hint')) + '</span>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-tp-leave><span>' + esc(t('term_leave')) + '</span></button></div>'
                + '<p class="dm-tp-msg" data-tp-msg role="status" hidden></p>'
                + '<div class="dm-tp-screen" data-tp-screen></div></div>';
            const q = selector => el.querySelector(selector);
            const screen = q('[data-tp-screen]'), statusEl = q('[data-tp-status]'), msgEl = q('[data-tp-msg]'), pickEl = q('[data-tp-pick]'), pickWrap = q('[data-tp-pick-wrap]');
            const startEl = q('[data-tp-start]'), leaveEl = q('[data-tp-leave]');

            function paint() {
                statusEl.textContent = t('term_status_' + phase);
                statusEl.dataset.phase = phase;
                msgEl.hidden = !message;
                msgEl.textContent = message;
                screen.hidden = !!message && phase !== 'connected' && phase !== 'closed';
                const label = phase === 'idle' ? (message ? '' : t('term_open')) : phase === 'closed' || phase === 'error' ? t('term_reconnect') : '';
                startEl.hidden = !label || !!blockedBy(targetFor(current), readonly());
                if (label) startEl.querySelector('span').textContent = label;
            }
            function paintPicker() {
                const list = targets();
                const sig = list.map(item => item.ref + '|' + item.label).join('\n') + '#' + current;
                if (sig === optionSig) return;
                optionSig = sig;
                pickWrap.hidden = list.length < 2;
                pickEl.innerHTML = list.map(item => '<option value="' + esc(item.ref) + '"' + (item.ref === current ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(item.label) + '</option>').join('');
            }

            // ---- xterm and the socket --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

            function ensureTerm() {
                if (term) return true;
                if (typeof window.Terminal !== 'function') return false;
                screen.hidden = false;
                term = new window.Terminal({
                    cursorBlink: true, scrollback: 2000, fontSize: 13, fontFamily: getComputedStyle(screen).fontFamily, minimumContrastRatio: 4.5,
                    theme: readTheme(screen)
                });
                if (window.FitAddon && window.FitAddon.FitAddon) { fit = new window.FitAddon.FitAddon(); term.loadAddon(fit); }
                term.open(screen);
                if (term.textarea) term.textarea.setAttribute('aria-label', t('term_input_label'));
                term.attachCustomKeyEventHandler(event => {
                    if (event.type === 'keydown' && event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey && !event.metaKey && (event.key === ']' || event.code === 'BracketRight')) { leave(); return false; }
                    return true;
                });
                term.onData(data => send(utf8(data)));
                term.onBinary(data => send(Uint8Array.from(data, ch => ch.charCodeAt(0))));
                // The keydown stays inside the screen: the app's shortcuts and the desktop's Spotlight never see what is typed here.
                screen.addEventListener('keydown', event => event.stopPropagation(), { signal });
                if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') { resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => queueFit()); resizeObserver.observe(screen); }
                return true;
            }
            function send(data) { if (socket && socket.readyState === 1) socket.send(data); }
            function doFit() {
                fitQueued = false;
                if (disposed || !term || !fit || !active || screen.clientWidth < 20 || screen.clientHeight < 20) return;
                try { fit.fit(); } catch (error) { return; }
                if (socket && socket.readyState === 1) socket.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'resize', cols: term.cols, rows: term.rows }));
            }
            function queueFit() { if (!fitQueued) { fitQueued = true; frame(doFit); } }

            function closeSocket(askEnd) {
                generation += 1;
                if (!socket) return;
                const old = socket;
                socket = null;
                old.onopen = old.onmessage = old.onerror = old.onclose = null;
                try {
                    if (askEnd && old.readyState === 1) old.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'end' }));

            }

            async function explainFailure(target, confirmed, mine) {
                const info = typeof diagnose === 'function' ? await diagnose(diagnosePath(config.hostId, target.ref, confirmed)) : null;
                if (disposed || generation !== mine) return;
                if (info && info.code === 'container_protected_confirmation_required' && !confirmed) {
                    if (typeof confirmProtected === 'function' && await confirmProtected(target, info) && !disposed && generation === mine) { void connect(target.ref, true); return; }
                    phase = 'idle';
                    message = '';
                } else {
                    phase = 'error';
                    message = info ? t('term_failed', { message: views.errorText(info) }) : t('term_failed_unknown');
                }
                paint();
            }

            // confirmed = the person said yes to the protected container already (the request then carries ?confirm=protected).
            async function connect(ref, confirmed) {
                if (disposed) return;
                closeSocket(true);
                current = ref;
                const target = targetFor(ref);
                const blocked = blockedBy(target, readonly());
                if (blocked) { phase = 'idle'; message = t(blocked); paintPicker(); paint(); return; }
                if (!ensureTerm()) { phase = 'error'; message = t('term_unavailable'); paintPicker(); paint(); return; }
                if (target.protected && !confirmed) {
                    phase = 'idle';
                    message = '';
                    paintPicker();
                    paint();
                    const before = generation;
                    if (typeof confirmProtected !== 'function' || !await confirmProtected(target, null) || disposed || current !== ref || generation !== before) return;
                    confirmed = true;
                }
                const mine = generation;
                phase = 'connecting';
                message = '';
                opened = false;
                term.reset();
                paintPicker();
                paint();
                let next;
                try { next = openSocket(socketUrl(where, config.hostId, ref, confirmed)); } catch (error) { phase = 'error'; message = t('term_failed_unknown'); paint(); return; }
                socket = next;
                next.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';
                next.onopen = () => {
                    if (generation !== mine || disposed) return;
                    opened = true;
                    phase = 'connected';
                    paint();
                    frame(() => { doFit(); if (wantFocus && active && term) { term.focus(); wantFocus = false; } });
                };
                next.onmessage = event => {
                    if (generation !== mine || disposed || !term) return;
                    term.write(typeof event.data === 'string' ? event.data : new Uint8Array(event.data));
                };
                next.onerror = () => { /* onclose follows and tells what happened */ };
                next.onclose = () => {
                    if (generation !== mine || disposed) return;
                    socket = null;
                    if (!opened) { phase = 'connecting'; paint(); void explainFailure(target, !!confirmed, mine); return; }
                    phase = 'closed';
                    term.write('\r\n[' + t('term_closed_line') + ']\r\n');
                    paint();
                };
            }

            function leave() {
                leaveEl.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            // ---- events --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

            leaveEl.addEventListener('click', leave, { signal });
            startEl.addEventListener('click', () => { wantFocus = true; void connect(current || (targets()[0] && targets()[0].ref) || '', false); }, { signal });
            pickEl.addEventListener('change', () => { wantFocus = false; void connect(pickEl.value, false); }, { signal });

            // First use: pick the first target. Whatever is possible starts at once; the rest explains itself.
            function start() {
                const list = targets();
                if (!current || !targetFor(current)) current = list.length ? list[0].ref : '';
                paintPicker();
                if (!current) { message = t(blockedBy(null, readonly())); paint(); return; }
                void connect(current, false);
            }
            paint();

            return {
                setActive(next) {
                    if (disposed || next === active) return;
                    active = !!next;
                    if (!active) return;
                    if (phase === 'idle' && !message && !opened) start();
                    else { queueFit(); frame(() => { doFit(); if (wantFocus && phase === 'connected' && term) { term.focus(); wantFocus = false; } }); }
                },
                // The list of containers changed: refresh the picker and the explanation; a running session is left alone.
                update() {
                    if (disposed) return;
                    if ((phase === 'idle' || phase === 'error') && !targetFor(current) && targets().length) { current = targets()[0].ref; optionSig = ''; }
                    paintPicker();

                    }
                },
                focus() { if (term && phase === 'connected') term.focus(); else wantFocus = true; },
                phase: () => phase,
                isActive: () => active,
                dispose() {
                    if (disposed) return;
                    disposed = true;
                    closeSocket(true);

                    resizeObserver?.disconnect();

                }

        }

        return { open };
    }

    window.DockerManagerTerminal = { create, socketUrl, diagnosePath, targetOf, stackTargets, blockedBy, readTheme };
})();
```

### Task D6: Views, stack builders and the panes module

**Files:**

- Modify (test): `scripts/test-docker-manager-ui.mjs`
- Modify (test): `ui/i18n_lint_test.go`
- Create: `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-panes.js`
- Modify: `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-stacks.js`
- Modify: `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-views.js`
- Modify: `ui/lang/desktop/{cs,da,de,el,en,es,fr,hi,it,ja,nl,no,pl,pt,sv,zh}.json`

Views: the Containers table gets an empty `data-load="host/id12"` placeholder cell per running container (the markup of the table never holds numbers, so a stats message cannot make the table differ from its last markup), group rows span six columns; `railGauges(snap)` is the host load area under a single host (CPU and memory as meters from the host stats, the Docker disk as bytes with a refresh button, a hint for a partial sample, paused data, a failed reading or the wait for the first sample); `banners` adds the compact "Live updates paused" banner for a paused host (not for one that has its own unreachable banner); `drawer(snap, row)` returns `{top, body, live}` (the Logs and Terminal tabs have no body: the app shows its persistent panel), with tab ids per panel and the phase 1 follow-up: the tab name is escaped in `data-tab-body` (and no id is built from it); the six new error codes of the stream and terminal routes plus `forbidden_origin`, `docker_hosts_unavailable` and `docker_disabled` get sentences, and a `host_unreachable` without a classified reason (an ended log stream) appends the message of the server; the one-shot `logsPanel` is removed. Stacks: five stack tabs, mounts for the two panels in the shell, load placeholders on running services (keyed by the first 12 characters of the container id of the service, which may come as the full one: the stream, its rings and the container list use the short id), the external row opens the project pane, and `projectHead`, `projectShell`, `projectOverview` build it (containers of the project and working directory, start, stop and restart, "Show in Containers"). `docker-manager-panes.js` mounts the panels (`drawer`, `stack`, `project`: built when their tab is first shown, kept while the pane stays on the same thing, following only while shown; a replaced mount builds again), fills the load cells in place (`patchLoads`: CPU and memory sparklines and a title with the network rate) and collects the visible ones (`visibleLoads`: rendered, inside the viewport, at most 50 per host).

```js
    // stack pane: five tabs, mounts for the follow panels, load placeholders on running services
    const detail = {
        name: 'shop', host_id: 'local', dir: '/opt/stacks/shop', compose_file: 'compose.yaml', has_env: false, status: 'running', services: { total: 2, running: 1 }, ports: [], created: 1760000000,
        service_list: [{ name: 'web', image: 'nginx', state: 'running', container_id: web.id, ports: [] }, { name: 'db', image: 'postgres', state: 'exited', exit_code: 1, container_id: idle.id, ports: [] }]
    };
    const stackSnap = tab => Object.assign({}, snapBase, { section: 'stacks', dirty: {}, canMutate: true, stackOps: {}, state: Object.assign({}, snapBase.state, { stack: { key: 'local/shop', hostId: 'local', name: 'shop', tab, status: 'ok', detail, error: null } }) });
    const head = stacks.head(stackSnap('logs'));
    assert.ok(['overview', 'compose', 'env', 'logs', 'terminal'].every(tab => head.includes('data-action="stack-tab" data-tab="' + tab + '"')) && /data-tab="logs"[^>]*aria-selected="true"/.test(head), 'five stack tabs');
    const shell = stacks.shell(stackSnap('overview').state.stack);
    assert.ok(shell.includes('data-panel="logs"') && shell.includes('data-mount="logs"') && shell.includes('data-panel="terminal"') && shell.includes('data-mount="terminal"') && /data-panel="logs"[^>]*hidden/.test(shell), 'the shell holds a mount per follow panel, hidden until its tab opens');
    const overview = stacks.overview(stackSnap('overview'));
    assert.ok(overview.includes('data-load="local/' + web.id + '"') && (overview.match(/data-load=/g) || []).length === 1, 'only the running service has a load placeholder');
    const withFullId = Object.assign({}, stackSnap('overview'), { state: Object.assign({}, stackSnap('overview').state, { stack: Object.assign({}, stackSnap('overview').state.stack, { detail: Object.assign({}, detail, { service_list: [{ name: 'web', image: 'nginx', state: 'running', container_id: web.full_id, ports: [] }] }) }) }) });
    const fullOverview = stacks.overview(withFullId);
    assert.ok(fullOverview.includes('data-load="local/' + web.id + '"') && fullOverview.includes('data-container-id="' + web.id + '"') && !fullOverview.includes(web.full_id), 'a service container that comes with its 64-character id is keyed by the 12-character id of the stream and of the container list');

    // the external project pane
    const projectSnap = tab => Object.assign({}, snapBase, { section: 'stacks', canMutate: true, state: Object.assign({}, snapBase.state, { project: { key: 'x:local/legacy', hostId: 'local', name: 'legacy', tab } }) });
    const phead = stacks.projectHead(projectSnap('overview'));
    assert.ok(phead.includes('data-action="project-tab" data-tab="overview"') && phead.includes('data-action="project-tab" data-tab="logs"') && !phead.includes('data-tab="compose"') && phead.includes('data-act="restart"') && phead.includes('data-action="close-project"') && phead.includes('title="/srv/legacy"'), 'two tabs, start/stop/restart, close, the working directory');
    assert.ok(!stacks.projectHead(Object.assign({}, projectSnap('overview'), { canMutate: false })).includes('data-act='), 'a read-only window shows no project actions');
    const pshell = stacks.projectShell({ key: 'x:local/legacy', tab: 'logs' });
    assert.ok(/data-panel="overview"[^>]*hidden/.test(pshell) && !/data-panel="logs"[^>]*hidden/.test(pshell) && pshell.includes('data-mount="logs"'), 'the project shell shows the open tab');
    const poverview = stacks.projectOverview(projectSnap('overview'));
    assert.ok(poverview.includes('legacy-app') && !poverview.includes('legacy-db') && poverview.includes('data-action="show-project"') && (poverview.match(/data-load=/g) || []).length === 1, 'the containers of this project and working directory only, with a load placeholder and a way to the Containers section');
    const gone = Object.assign({}, projectSnap('overview'), { state: Object.assign({}, projectSnap('overview').state, { stacks: {}, byHost: { local: { containers: [], loaded: true } } }) });
    assert.ok(stacks.projectHead(gone).includes('project_gone') && stacks.projectOverview(gone).includes('project_gone'), 'a project that left the listing says so');
    const list = stacks.list(Object.assign({}, snapBase, { section: 'stacks', hostStates: { local: 'ok', h_nas: 'ok' }, prepareActive: {}, sgroups: sm2.stackGroups(hosts, stacksByHost, rows, { scope: 'all', query: '' }), stackCounts: { total: 1 } }));
    assert.ok(list.includes('data-action="open-project" data-host-id="local" data-project="legacy"') && !list.includes('data-action="show-project"'), 'an external row opens the project pane');
}

// ---- panes: follow panels follow their tab, load cells are patched in place, the visible ones are subscribed -------------
{
    // a tiny DOM: just enough for the panes module (querySelector(All), dataset, hidden, getBoundingClientRect, getClientRects)
    const makeEl = (props = {}) => {
        const el = Object.assign({ hidden: false, dataset: {}, children: [], innerHTML: '', title: '', rect: { top: 0, bottom: 20 }, shown: true }, props);
        el.getBoundingClientRect = () => el.rect;
        el.getClientRects = () => (el.shown ? [el.rect] : []);
        el.querySelector = selector => { const match = /\[data-(live-panel|mount)="(\w+)"\]/.exec(selector); return match ? (el.mounts && el.mounts[match[2]]) || null : null; };
        el.querySelectorAll = selector => (selector === '[data-load]' ? el.cells || [] : []);
        return el;
    };
    const calls = [];
    const makePanel = kind => { const panel = { kind, active: false, disposed: false, updates: 0, focused: 0, setActive(v) { panel.active = v; calls.push([kind, 'active', v]); }, update() { panel.updates += 1; }, focus() { panel.focused += 1; }, dispose() { panel.disposed = true; calls.push([kind, 'dispose']); } }; return panel; };
    const opened = { logs: [], terminal: [] };
    const logsApi = { open: (el, target) => { const p = makePanel('logs'); p.target = target; p.el = el; opened.logs.push(p); return p; } };
    const termApi = { open: (el, config) => { const p = makePanel('terminal'); p.config = config; p.el = el; opened.terminal.push(p); return p; } };
    const webRow = { key: 'local/' + 'web'.padEnd(64, '0'), c: container('web') };
    const store = { state: { stack: null, byHost: { local: { containers: [webRow.c] } } }, canMutate: () => true, liveRing: (host, id) => (id === 'good' ? [{ t: 1, cpu: 5, mem: 1048576, net_rx: 0, net_tx: 0 }, { t: 2001, cpu: 7, mem: 2097152, net_rx: 2048, net_tx: 0 }] : []) };
    const panes = full.DockerManagerPanes.create({ t: (key, params) => key + JSON.stringify(params || {}), model: model, charts: full.DockerManagerCharts, logs: logsApi, terminal: termApi, store, findRow: key => (key === webRow.key ? webRow : null), lang: 'en' });
    const live = makeEl({ mounts: { logs: makeEl(), terminal: makeEl() } });

    panes.drawer(live, { key: webRow.key, hostId: 'local', id: webRow.c.full_id, tab: 'overview' }, false);
    eq([opened.logs.length, opened.terminal.length], [0, 0], 'nothing is built before its tab is shown');
    panes.drawer(live, { key: webRow.key, hostId: 'local', id: webRow.c.full_id, tab: 'logs' }, false);
    eq([opened.logs.length, opened.logs[0].active, live.mounts.logs.hidden, live.mounts.terminal.hidden], [1, true, false, true], 'the logs panel is built and follows');
    eq(plain(opened.logs[0].target), { kind: 'container', hostId: 'local', ref: webRow.c.full_id, label: 'web', services: undefined }, 'it follows the container by its full id');
    panes.drawer(live, { key: webRow.key, hostId: 'local', id: webRow.c.full_id, tab: 'terminal' }, true);
    eq([opened.logs[0].active, opened.terminal.length, opened.terminal[0].active, opened.terminal[0].focused, opened.terminal[0].config.autofocus], [false, 1, true, 1, true], 'switching tabs stops one and starts the other, the panels stay');
    eq(plain(opened.terminal[0].config.targets().map(item => [item.ref, item.state])), [[webRow.c.full_id, 'ok']], 'the terminal asks the current container list');
    assert.equal(opened.terminal[0].config.readonly(), false);
    panes.drawer(live, { key: webRow.key, hostId: 'local', id: webRow.c.full_id, tab: 'logs' }, false);
    assert.equal(opened.logs.length, 1, 'coming back reuses the panel');
    panes.drawer(live, { key: 'local/other', hostId: 'local', id: 'x', tab: 'logs' }, false);
    eq([opened.logs[0].disposed, opened.terminal[0].disposed], [true, true], 'another container or a closed drawer shuts the panels down');
    panes.drawer(live, null, false);

    // the stack pane: the panel is built on its tab, services reach the chips, a replaced mount builds again, a covered pane follows nothing
    const shellEl = makeEl({ mounts: { logs: makeEl(), terminal: makeEl() } });
    const stackState = tab => ({ key: 'local/shop', hostId: 'local', name: 'shop', tab, status: 'ok', detail: { service_list: [{ name: 'web', state: 'running', container_id: webRow.c.id }, { name: 'db', state: 'exited', container_id: 'ffffffffffff' }] } });
    store.state.stack = stackState('logs');
    const before = opened.logs.length;
    panes.stack(shellEl, store.state.stack, true, false);
    const stackLogs = opened.logs[before];
    eq([stackLogs.target.kind, stackLogs.target.name, stackLogs.target.services, stackLogs.active], ['stack', 'shop', ['web', 'db'], true]);
    panes.stack(shellEl, store.state.stack, false, false);
    assert.equal(stackLogs.active, false, 'a covered pane follows nothing');
    shellEl.mounts.logs = makeEl();
    panes.stack(shellEl, store.state.stack, true, false);
    eq([stackLogs.disposed, opened.logs.length - before], [true, 2], 'a mount that was replaced gets a new panel');
    store.state.stack = stackState('terminal');
    panes.stack(shellEl, store.state.stack, true, false);
    eq(plain(opened.terminal[opened.terminal.length - 1].config.targets().map(item => item.label)), ['web'], 'the stack terminal offers its running services');
    panes.stack(shellEl, null, true, false);
    assert.equal(opened.terminal[opened.terminal.length - 1].disposed, true, 'no stack, no panels');

    // the project pane
    const projectEl = makeEl({ mounts: { logs: makeEl() } });
    panes.project(projectEl, { key: 'x:local/legacy', hostId: 'local', name: 'legacy', tab: 'logs' }, true);
    const projectLogs = opened.logs[opened.logs.length - 1];
    eq([projectLogs.target.kind, projectLogs.target.name, projectLogs.active], ['project', 'legacy', true]);
    panes.project(projectEl, null, true);
    assert.equal(projectLogs.disposed, true);

    // load cells: filled from the ring, only the asked ones, nothing again for an unchanged ring
    const cell = (key, extra = {}) => makeEl({ dataset: { load: key }, ...extra });
    const good = cell('local/good'), other = cell('local/none');
    const table = makeEl({ cells: [good, other] });
    panes.patchLoads(table, new Set(['local/good']));
    assert.ok(good.innerHTML.includes('dm-load-line') && good.innerHTML.includes('>7.0%<') && good.title.startsWith('stat_title') && good.title.includes('"rx":"1.0 KB"'), 'a cell shows CPU and memory and names the network rate in its title');
    eq([other.innerHTML, other.dataset.sig], ['', undefined], 'a cell that was not asked for stays as it is');
    good.innerHTML = 'marker';
    panes.patchLoads(table);
    assert.equal(good.innerHTML, 'marker', 'an unchanged ring is not painted again');
    store.liveRing = () => [];
    panes.patchLoads(table);
    eq([good.innerHTML, other.innerHTML], ['', ''], 'a container without points shows no cell');

    // which containers are on screen: rendered, inside the viewport, at most 50 per host, once each
    const viewport = makeEl({ rect: { top: 100, bottom: 300 } });
    const many = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => cell('local/c' + String(i).padStart(11, '0'), { rect: { top: 150, bottom: 170 } }));
    const entries = [
        { root: makeEl({ cells: [cell('local/in', { rect: { top: 120, bottom: 140 } }), cell('local/above', { rect: { top: 10, bottom: 30 } }), cell('local/below', { rect: { top: 400, bottom: 420 } }), cell('local/hidden', { shown: false }), cell('h_nas/n1', { rect: { top: 200, bottom: 220 } }), cell('local/in', { rect: { top: 130, bottom: 150 } })] }), viewport },
        { root: makeEl({ cells: many }), viewport }
    ];
    const visible = panes.visibleLoads(entries);
    eq([visible['h_nas'], visible.local.slice(0, 2), visible.local.length], [['n1'], ['in', 'c00000000000'], 50], 'rendered, inside the viewport, once each, at most 50 per host');
    eq(panes.visibleLoads([{ root: null, viewport }]), {});
    panes.dispose();
}

// ---- the lint scheduler: one request per quiet period, the newest answer wins, aborted requests are silent ------------------------
{
    const { createLinter, LINT_DELAY_MS } = full.DockerManagerEditor;
```

```js
            return panel('overview', '<div class="dm-sd-overview" data-project-overview></div>') + panel('logs', '<div class="dm-mount" data-mount="logs"></div>');
        }

        function projectRow(snap, project, c) {
            const status = model.statusOf(c), name = model.containerName(c), key = project.hostId + '/' + model.containerId(c);
            const ports = model.portItems(c.ports).filter(item => item.published).map(item => '<span class="dm-port">' + esc(item.label) + '</span>').join('');
            const load = status.tone === 'ok' ? '<span class="dm-svc-load" data-load="' + esc(project.hostId + '/' + String(c.id).slice(0, 12)) + '"></span>' : '';
            return '<li class="dm-svc" data-tone="' + status.tone + '">' + dot(status.tone) + '<div class="dm-svc-text"><span class="dm-name">' + esc(name) + '</span><span class="dm-sub" title="' + esc(c.image) + '">'
                + esc([views.statusLabel(status), c.compose_service, model.shortImage(c.image)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')) + '</span></div>' + load + (ports ? '<span class="dm-svc-ports">' + ports + '</span>' : '')
                + iconButton('open-container', t('svc_open_container', { name }), 'inspect', ' data-row-key="' + esc(key) + '"', { focus: 'pc:' + c.id }) + '</li>';
        }

        function projectOverview(snap) {
            const project = snap.state.project;
            if (!project) return '';
            const p = projectOf(snap, project), list = projectContainers(snap, project), parts = [];
            parts.push('<p class="dm-note">' + glyph('folder') + '<span>' + esc(t('project_note')) + '</span></p>');
            if (!list.length) parts.push('<p class="dm-muted">' + esc(p ? t('project_no_containers') : t('project_gone')) + '</p>');
            else parts.push('<ul class="dm-svclist" aria-label="' + esc(t('nav_containers')) + '">' + list.map(c => projectRow(snap, project, c)).join('') + '</ul>');
            parts.push(button('show-project', t('project_show_containers'), { glyph: 'containers', attrs: ' data-project="' + esc(project.name) + '"', focus: 'pd:show' }));
            return parts.join('');
        }
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-panes.js`.**

```js
/* Docker Manager panes: the glue between the app and the things that live as long as a pane is open. A classic script
   (window.DockerManagerPanes) with no DOM work at load.
   - Follow panels: the log panel and the terminal panel of the container drawer, the stack pane and the external project pane are
     created the first time their tab is shown, kept (hidden) while the pane stays on the same container, stack or project, shut
     down when it changes or closes, and told to follow only while their tab is visible. A panel whose mount element was replaced
     is built again.
   - Load cells: [data-load="host/containerid"] placeholders (table rows, service lines) are filled in place with the CPU and
     memory sparklines of the live stream. Nothing here repaints a table; a stats message touches only the cells of its container.
   - visibleLoads: which of those cells are on screen, for the subscription of the stream (at most 50 containers per host). */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const MAX_IDS = 50;

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, model, charts, logs, terminal, store, findRow, lang } = deps;
        const helpers = window.DockerManagerTerminal;
        const slots = new Map();

        function slotFor(name, key) {
            let slot = slots.get(name);
            if (slot && slot.key !== key) { release(name); slot = null; }
            if (!slot) { slot = { key, logs: null, terminal: null, logsEl: null, terminalEl: null }; slots.set(name, slot); }
            return slot;
        }
        function release(name) {
            const slot = slots.get(name);
            if (!slot) return;
            slot.logs?.dispose();
            slot.terminal?.dispose();
            slots.delete(name);
        }

        // Creates the panels of a slot on demand and follows only the one whose tab is `tab` ('' = the pane is not shown).
        function sync(name, key, tab, mounts, make, focus) {
            const slot = slotFor(name, key);
            if (slot.logs && slot.logsEl !== mounts.logs) { slot.logs.dispose(); slot.logs = null; }
            if (slot.terminal && slot.terminalEl !== mounts.terminal) { slot.terminal.dispose(); slot.terminal = null; }
            if (tab === 'logs' && !slot.logs && mounts.logs) { slot.logs = make.logs(mounts.logs); slot.logsEl = mounts.logs; }
            if (tab === 'terminal' && !slot.terminal && mounts.terminal) { slot.terminal = make.terminal(mounts.terminal, focus); slot.terminalEl = mounts.terminal; }
            slot.logs?.setActive(tab === 'logs');
            slot.terminal?.setActive(tab === 'terminal');
            if (tab === 'terminal' && focus) slot.terminal?.focus();
            return slot;
        }

        const makeLogs = (target, services) => el => logs.open(el, Object.assign({ services }, target));
        const makeTerminal = (hostId, targets) => (el, focus) => terminal.open(el, { hostId, targets, readonly: () => !store.canMutate(), autofocus: !!focus });

        // The container drawer. liveEl holds [data-live-panel="logs"|"terminal"]; detail is state.detail or null.
        function drawer(liveEl, detail, focus) {
            if (!detail) { release('drawer'); return; }
            const row = findRow(detail.key);
            if (!row) { release('drawer'); return; }
            const mounts = { logs: liveEl.querySelector('[data-live-panel="logs"]'), terminal: liveEl.querySelector('[data-live-panel="terminal"]') };
            if (mounts.logs) mounts.logs.hidden = detail.tab !== 'logs';
            if (mounts.terminal) mounts.terminal.hidden = detail.tab !== 'terminal';
            const target = { kind: 'container', hostId: detail.hostId, ref: detail.id, label: model.containerName(row.c) };
            const slot = sync('drawer', detail.key, detail.tab, mounts, {
                logs: makeLogs(target),
                terminal: makeTerminal(detail.hostId, () => { const current = findRow(detail.key); return current ? [helpers.targetOf(current.c)] : []; })
            }, focus);
            slot.terminal?.update();
        }

        // The stack pane. shellEl holds [data-mount="logs"|"terminal"]; `shown` is false while the drawer or the new-stack view covers it.
        function stack(shellEl, current, shown, focus) {
            if (!current || current.status !== 'ok' || !current.detail) { release('stack'); return; }
            const services = (Array.isArray(current.detail.service_list) ? current.detail.service_list : []).map(service => service.name).filter(Boolean);
            const mounts = { logs: shellEl.querySelector('[data-mount="logs"]'), terminal: shellEl.querySelector('[data-mount="terminal"]') };
            const containers = () => { const entry = store.state.byHost[current.hostId]; return entry ? entry.containers : []; };
            const slot = sync('stack', current.key, shown ? current.tab : '', mounts, {
                logs: makeLogs({ kind: 'stack', hostId: current.hostId, name: current.name, label: current.name }, services),
                terminal: makeTerminal(current.hostId, () => { const now = store.state.stack; return now && now.key === current.key && now.detail ? helpers.stackTargets(now.detail, containers()) : []; })
            }, focus);
            slot.logs?.update({ services });
            slot.terminal?.update();
        }

        // The external project pane (overview and logs).
        function project(shellEl, current, shown) {
            if (!current) { release('project'); return; }
            const mounts = { logs: shellEl.querySelector('[data-mount="logs"]'), terminal: null };
            sync('project', current.key, shown ? current.tab : '', mounts, { logs: makeLogs({ kind: 'project', hostId: current.hostId, name: current.name, label: current.name }), terminal: null }, false);
        }

        // ---- load cells --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        function fill(el, points) {
            const last = points[points.length - 1], sig = last ? last.t + ':' + points.length : '';
            if (el.dataset.sig === sig) return;
            el.dataset.sig = sig;
            el.innerHTML = last ? charts.loadCell(points, { lang }) : '';
            el.title = last ? t('stat_title', {
                cpu: charts.percent(last.cpu, lang), mem: charts.bytes(last.mem, lang), rx: charts.bytes(charts.rate(points, 'net_rx'), lang), tx: charts.bytes(charts.rate(points, 'net_tx'), lang)
            }) : '';
        }
        const splitKey = key => ({ host: key.slice(0, key.indexOf('/')), id: key.slice(key.indexOf('/') + 1) });

        // Fills the cells of the containers in `keys` (a Set of "host/id"), or every cell when `keys` is omitted.
        function patchLoads(rootEl, keys) {
            for (const el of rootEl.querySelectorAll('[data-load]')) {
                const key = el.dataset.load;
                if (keys && !keys.has(key)) continue;
                const part = splitKey(key);
                fill(el, store.liveRing(part.host, part.id));
            }
        }

        // entries = [{root, viewport}]: the containers whose load cells are rendered and inside the viewport, {host: [id]}, at most 50 per host.
        function visibleLoads(entries) {
            const out = {};
            for (const entry of entries) {
                if (!entry.root || !entry.viewport) continue;
                const box = entry.viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
                for (const el of entry.root.querySelectorAll('[data-load]')) {
                    if (!el.getClientRects().length) continue;
                    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                    if (rect.bottom < box.top || rect.top > box.bottom) continue;
                    const part = splitKey(el.dataset.load), ids = out[part.host] || (out[part.host] = []);
                    if (ids.length < MAX_IDS && !ids.includes(part.id)) ids.push(part.id);
                }
            }
            return out;
        }

        function dispose() { for (const name of [...slots.keys()]) release(name); }

        return { drawer, stack, project, release, patchLoads, visibleLoads, dispose };
    }

    window.DockerManagerPanes = { create, MAX_IDS };
})();
```

### Task D7: Stylesheet, module loader and wiring test

**Files:**

- Modify: `ui/css/desktop-app-docker-manager.css`
- Modify (test): `ui/desktop_docker_manager_wiring_test.go`
- Modify: `ui/js/desktop/core/module-loader.js`

The rail splits into a scrolling body (`data-rail`) and a fixed gauge area (`data-rail-gauges`); in a narrow window the rail stays a strip and the gauges go. The table has a CPU / Memory column that leaves before the ports when the table gets narrow (the column widths are re-balanced so that the name keeps about 200 px at the default window width). New rules: sparklines (the SVG classes of D1, `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke` because the SVG is stretched), load cells, gauges (`data-level` colours from the status tokens), the compact banner, the follow panels (log view, chips, notices, the "New lines" button, stderr marker, service hues), the terminal panel and its `--dm-term-*` colour properties (tokens only, mapped from the status tokens), and the two wrappers of the drawer that take no part in the layout. No new motion. The loader entry loads `xterm.css`, `xterm.min.js` and `xterm-addon-fit.min.js` (no WebGL renderer) first and the five new modules in dependency order; the wiring test pins both.

- [ ] **Step 2: Replace the whole content of `ui/desktop_docker_manager_wiring_test.go` with this (57 lines).**

```go
package ui

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The loader, the shell routing, the window sizing and the generated main bundle know the Docker Manager app, and its
// sixteen modules load in the order they depend on each other, after the two xterm files the terminal panel needs (no WebGL
// renderer). Behaviour is covered by scripts/test-docker-manager-ui.mjs and TestDesktopDockerManagerBrowser.
func TestDockerManagerWiring(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	loader := readDesktopAssetText(t, "js/desktop/core/module-loader.js")
	entry := regexp.MustCompile(`'docker-manager': \{ styles: appStyles\('/css/xterm\.css', '/css/desktop-app-docker-manager\.css'\), scripts: \[([^\]]*)\] \}`).FindStringSubmatch(loader)
	if entry == nil {
		t.Fatal("module-loader.js must register the docker-manager assets")
	}
	var scripts []string
	for _, match := range regexp.MustCompile(`'/js/desktop/apps/([a-z-]+\.js)'`).FindAllStringSubmatch(entry[1], -1) {
		scripts = append(scripts, match[1])
	}
	want := []string{
		"docker-manager-model.js", "docker-manager-stack-model.js", "docker-manager-charts.js", "docker-manager-store.js", "docker-manager-live.js", "docker-manager-views.js",
		"docker-manager-stacks.js", "docker-manager-editor.js", "docker-manager-ops.js", "docker-manager-logs.js", "docker-manager-terminal.js", "docker-manager-panes.js",
		"docker-manager-palette.js", "docker-manager-dialogs.js", "docker-manager-newstack.js", "docker-manager.js",
	}
	if strings.Join(scripts, ",") != strings.Join(want, ",") {
		t.Fatalf("docker-manager scripts = %v, want %v", scripts, want)
	}
	// The terminal panel needs xterm and its fit addon before the app modules; the WebGL renderer stays out.
	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(entry[1]), "'/js/vendor/xterm.min.js', '/js/vendor/xterm-addon-fit.min.js', '/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-model.js'") {
		t.Fatalf("docker-manager must load xterm and the fit addon first: %s", entry[1])
	}
	if strings.Contains(entry[1], "webgl") {
		t.Fatal("docker-manager must not load the xterm WebGL renderer")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(loader, "'docker-manager': ['docker_manager']") {
		t.Fatal("module-loader.js must load the docker_manager translation section for the app")
	}

	for file, markers := range map[string][]string{
		"js/desktop/core/menus-and-routing.js":    {"appId === 'docker-manager' && window.DockerManagerApp", "window.DockerManagerApp.render(contentEl(id), id,"},
		"js/desktop/core/desktop-foundation.js":   {"'docker-manager': 'DockerManagerApp'"},
		"js/desktop/core/window-shell-runtime.js": {"'docker-manager': { width: 1180, height: 760 }", "appId === 'docker-manager') return { width: 440, height: 400 }"},
		"js/desktop/bundles/main.bundle.js":       {"appId === 'docker-manager' && window.DockerManagerApp", "'docker-manager': 'DockerManagerApp'", "'docker-manager': { width: 1180, height: 760 }"},
	} {
		source := readDesktopAssetText(t, file)
		for _, marker := range markers {
			if !strings.Contains(source, marker) {
				t.Errorf("%s is missing %q (run npm run build:ui after editing the core files)", file, marker)
			}
		}
	}
}
```
